parts.name: Knee-High Socks
parts.desc: plain white cotton knee-high socks with a ribbed cuff just below the knee: the foot pieces are socked feet (soft rounded sock, no shoe, no sole), the shafts are smooth white sock fabric. The boot shaft pieces are only the leg, from just below the knee down to the ankle, with no foot on them; the shoe pieces are only the foot part.

parts.name: Bikini Top Female
parts.desc: a bright coral bandeau bikini top: exactly the same strapless shape, size and position as the input bra (two cups side by side with a band under them), no straps, no ties above the cups, solid coral fabric with a small ring between the cups

parts.name: Bikini Bottoms Female
parts.desc: bikini bottoms in bright coral with thin string ties at the hips; the two small leg pieces are just the thin edge of the leg openings

parts.name: Classic High Heels
parts.desc: glossy black patent leather stiletto court shoes with pointed toes and tall thin heels. The sheet has three shoes: the top two are side views (toe pointing right); the bottom one is the same shoe seen from the FRONT, toe pointing straight at the viewer, small and narrow like the input's bottom piece - not a side view and not a back view.

parts.name: Knee-High Boots
parts.desc: sleek knee-high black leather fashion boots with slim block heels and a side zip. The boot shaft pieces are only the leg, from just below the knee down to the ankle, with no foot on them; the shoe pieces are only the foot part.
